faq.q: What is the price of plots for sale in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Plots range ₹3,500–₹5,000 per sq.ft. for basic layouts, with premium CMDA/DTCP schemes at ₹6,500–₹8,000+ per sq.ft. A 1,000 sq.ft. plot typically costs ₹35–₹60 lakh.

faq.q: Is Paruthipattu a good place to invest in a plot?
faq.a: Yes — infrastructure upgrades, highway proximity, and industrial hub access support good appreciation plus rental potential.

faq.q: How much have property prices appreciated in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Average annual appreciation of around 15–17% has been recorded over the past two to three years, with future price growth expected to remain healthy.

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying land in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Typically 7% of the market value (or circle value) plus 4% as registration charges, for residential plots in Tamil Nadu.

faq.q: Can I get a home loan for a plot in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Yes — banks offer plot loans up to 60–70% of property value for CMDA/DTCP-approved layouts.

faq.q: Are plots in Paruthipattu CMDA or DTCP approved?
faq.a: Many reputable layouts offer CMDA or DTCP approval; verification per project is recommended, and OmShakthy's plots typically carry such approvals.

faq.q: What documents should I check before buying a plot in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Original sale deed, latest patta, encumbrance certificate, layout approval (CMDA/DTCP), registered sale documents, tax receipts, and plot number accuracy.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy plots in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Yes — NRIs may purchase approved residential plots using NRE/NRO accounts, with end-to-end assistance including FEMA guidance.

faq.q: Are there gated community plots in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Yes — gated communities offer 24/7 security, internal roads, streetlights, parks, and clubhouses within CMDA/DTCP-approved layouts.

faq.q: What sizes of plots are available in Paruthipattu?
faq.a: Sizes range from compact 600–800 sq.ft. to mid-sized 1,200–1,800 sq.ft. and larger 2,400+ sq.ft. plots suitable for villas.
